senses.gloss: ch. same, to sift. Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵇ bot. הן דח׳ וכ׳ he who (on the Sabbath) sifts powder of gypsum &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:7:2">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵇ</cite> top <he>מכיון שהוא מרחיק ואת ח׳ וכ׳</he> because its meshes are wide and you may sift flour through it; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 4:1:2">Y. Ned. IV, beg. 38ᶜ</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00215"><he>זוֹסְמָא</he></cite>.
